act_title: The Academy of Scientific and Innovative Research Act, 2011
title: 3rd April, 2012 [except sub-section (2) of section 5], vide notification No. S.O. 709(E), dated 2nd April, 2012, _see
text:
1. 3rd April, 2012 [except sub-section (2) of section 5], vide notification No. S.O. 709(E), dated 2nd April, 2012, _see_
Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, sec. 3(ii).
26th June, 2013 [sub-sec. (2) of section 5], vide notification No. S.O. 1850(E), dated 26th June, 2013, see Gazette of India,
Extraordinary, Part II, sec. 3(ii).
. _Vide notification No. S.O. 3912(E), dated 30th October, 2019, this Act is made applicable to the Union territory of_
Jammu and Kashmir and the Union territory of Ladakh.
